parameter_description: The maximum number of search results to return.
The region to search in. Defaults to 'wt-wt' (No region).
The URL to fetch content from. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'.

The mode to process the fetched content. `raw` returns the raw HTML content; `markdown` converts raw HTML content to Markdown format for better readability, using html2text; `truncate` extracts and cleans text by removing scripts, styles, and extraneous whitespace.
The processed web content as a string.
